text.p: The European Advertising Standards Alliance said on Thursday it had set up a working party and a web site on the issue of self-regulation.

The working party will examine the possibilities of converging national codes of practice and to assess the implications of this for the cross-border complaints system which the alliance currently coordinates.
It will also look at the implications in helping establish new systems in central and eastern Europe, it said.

The Alliance said it had set up the web site http://www.easa-alliance.org to focus on arguments for self-regulation being extended to include the ever-growing network of cyberspace as well as the problems and needs of such a system.
